mapper.sql: SELECT l.id, l.athlete_id, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.reason, l.training_limit, l.next_review_date, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, l.operate_time, a.name AS athlete_name FROM apms_rtp_log l LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON l.athlete_id = a.athlete_id
mapper.select: WHERE l.athlete_id = #{athleteId} ORDER BY l.operate_time DESC, l.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_rtp_log ( athlete_id, from_status, to_status, reason, training_limit, next_review_date, operator_id, operator_name, operate_time ) VALUES ( #{athleteId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{trainingLimit}, #{nextReviewDate}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, sysdate() )
